'''HR-02 Omni Droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model designed by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]]. It's purpose was to assist in holo-reconstructions, however their drawback was in increased power consumption. Such units were used by the GSI team working on the [[Emperor's Eye (temple)|Emperor's Eye]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] during the [[Invasion of Ziost]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
HR-02 Omni Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during a Daily mission on Ziost.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
